connected_players.label: [%key:common::config_entries::connected_players::label%]
connected_players.description: The Music Assistant players to expose via AirPlay. Every selected player is advertised as its own AirPlay receiver; audio streamed to it plays on that player. Leave empty to keep the plugin idle.

publish_name_template.label: [%key:common::config_entries::publish_name_template::label%]
publish_name_template.description: How each receiver shown in the AirPlay device list is named, based on the connected player's name.

manifest.description: Receive AirPlay audio streams and use them as a source in Music Assistant.
